name: Peter Grossenbacher
abstract_title: Mapping Phenomenal Landscapes of Psychedelic Journeys: A Multi-Medicine Comparative Study across Ayahuasca, LSD, Mescaline, and Psilocybin
abstract: What is it like to swim in different streams of psychedelic consciousness? Careful delineation of experiential phenomena occurring in psychedelic journeys establishes a needed foundation for systematically characterizing psychedelically accessed consciousness.
